An overview of this role
As a Threat Research Engineer, you’ll take ideas from the first question to a working proof of concept, deploy it, and analyze the results yourself. This is a full-stack role, with AI central to how we work. You’ll build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection, and use AI tools every day to move faster.
What you’ll do
Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.
Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools.
Analyze software supply chain incidents and events.
Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection.
Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work.
Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories.
Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences.
Take part in on-call or operational support where your team's ownership model requires it.
What you’ll bring
Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with both a developer mindset and an adversarial mindset: you can build systems and think about how to break them.
Demonstrated experience using AI in real work, such as building with large language model APIs or agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or agent SDKs.
Strong programming skills in Go or Python, with good software engineering practices including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery, and maintainable code.
Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.
Understanding of how package ecosystems work and how software supply chain attacks happen.
Ability to map possible attack vectors, name trade-offs, and make data-driven decisions, balancing quality and speed with customer outcomes in mind while keeping up with security and AI industry trends.
Clear writing that explains findings to both engineers and a general audience.
Helpful, but not required: published vulnerability findings; security research on AI agents, large language model applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers; Google Cloud Platform experience; or infrastructure as code experience with Terraform or OpenTofu.
You don’t need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing engines. A high-level understanding is enough.
About the team
The Threat Research group researches security threats as they emerge and turns what we learn into protection for GitLab customers. We maintain the GitLab Advisory Database, which powers GitLab’s dependency scanning. We also build detection capabilities, do original vulnerability research, and publish what we find. Recent work includes the Shai-Hulud npm worm and a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Serena, a popular MCP coding agent. You can read more on the Security Labs blog .

About us

Garage powers the exchange of critical assets across America’s essential industries. We started with fire departments, where purchasing mission-critical vehicles and equipment used to take months of paperwork, phone calls, and delays. Our agentic platform automates the entire transaction: discovery, payments, freight, paperwork, warranty, and financing. What once took months now takes minutes.

In under a year, we’ve expanded to cities and towns in all 50 states and grown revenue more than 10x. Based in New York, we’ve raised $18M from Y Combinator, Initialized Capital, Infinity Ventures, FJ Labs, and other leading investors. We’re moving fast, growing quickly, and just getting started.

 

About the role

Growth engineering at Garage builds the systems that turn our sales motion into a machine. The industry runs on PDFs, phone calls, and software built in 2003, and we'd rather build the modern version in-house than wire together someone else's tools.

You'll work closely with our sales team and the dealers, manufacturers, fleet operators, and government buyers who move specialty assets across the country. This involves owning the data infrastructure, internal tools, and AI-powered workflows that fill our pipeline.

 - Build the data infrastructure that finds every prospect in the industry by turning fragmented data into pipelines.

 - Ship internal tools that make our sales team dramatically more effective. This includes outbound automation, lead routing, sequencing, deal-room tooling.

 - Apply AI and LLMs to unstructured data and turn it into signals that fill our pipeline.

 - Build agents that work in the background to compound our sales advantage.

 

What we’re looking for

 - You think in systems, not tickets.

 - You get excited by operating in a high-performance startup environment.

 - You would love to be customer-facing.

 - You play for the front of the jersey, having strong opinions, a willingness to question the status quo, and a drive to become a real expert in whatever space you work in. All while being a great team communicator.

 

Required

 - Extremely AI-native, living on the cutting edge. AI is how you ship.

 - A track record of shipping high-quality products at scale, including with and for agents.

 - Experience designing and working with scalable databases and APIs.

 

Nice to have

 - Startup experience as a technical co-founder or early engineer at a Series A/B/C startup.

 - Experience working with messy real-world data from analog sources.

 - Familiarity with sales and marketing automation tools (Clay, HubSpot, Salesforce, Apollo).

 - 2+ years of experience.

 

Our Values

 - Take Big Swings. We are here to transform an overlooked industry—not make small improvements around the edges. We set ambitious goals, take calculated risks, and push through setbacks. We never trade lasting impact for short-term comfort.

 - Customers Come First. Our customers operate in an industry burdened by slow, expensive, and outdated processes. We attack the problems that cost them the most and measure our success by the time and money we give back to them.

 - Play For the Front of the Jersey. We put the mission ahead of ourselves. We challenge each other directly, support each other relentlessly, and step up whenever the team needs us. We win together, and we have fun doing it.

 - All Gas, No Ego. Building something that matters takes relentless effort. We move fast, take ownership, and see hard problems through. When we fall short, we own it, learn quickly, and come back stronger.

 

Why Join Garage?

 - Do work that matters. Our platform helps people buy the assets that local communities rely on to keep their communities safe, clean, and operating every day.

 - Help shape the company. Join as one of our first 40 employees and work directly alongside the founders.

 - Make an outsized impact. You’ll join a talent-dense, high-performance team where every person moves the company forward.

 - Build from a strong foundation. We’ve raised $18M, including a $13.5M Series A, from Y Combinator, Initialized Capital, Infinity Ventures, FJ Labs, and other leading investors.

 - 100% medical, dental and vision insurance coverage

 - Unlimited PTO (in addition to company observed holidays)

 - Daily lunch & dinner (for employees based in NYC)

 - $100/month wellness stipend

 - 401(k) w/ employer match

 - Pre-tax commuter benefits

 - Annual team offsite

 - Relocation assistance
